helpIntro.message: I read AI answers out loud in fun voices and help you understand them. Tap a topic:

helpListenBody.message: Ask Claude, Grok or Gemini anything. Tap Listen for reading level, voice and auto-read; tap it again to close the panel. With Listen off, the widget stays compact and I won't auto-read new answers, but Play, Read selection and Make video still work. Make video, at the bottom of the widget, exports the last reply you played. The slider is 1 super simple, 5 expert.

helpGesturesBody.message: Drag me by the top bar. Long-press me for the menu (size, characters, mute). Double-tap me to open the helper. Tap me fast or rub me to tickle me.

helpHelperBody.message: Double-tap and type or say things like "switch to Old Oakley", "talk slower", "simpler please" or "talk like a genius". I change the setting for you.

helpAskBody.message: Tap Ask to open it, or tap it again to close. Key points gives the short version. Paraphrase says it in plain words in your chosen character. Ask a follow-up, or Expound to go deeper.

helpTownBody.message: Pick a few characters and they each take a part of the answer, like a little town meeting. Big Sal, Old Oakley, Big Play Ray and Elias are the core crew.

helpSocialBody.message: On X, Facebook and Instagram, tap the "Summarize" pill on a post. The character you picked (the one picker in the widget) writes the summary, draft replies and videos. The Make video button at the bottom of the widget is always there, even if Post is closed: it uses that post's latest summary, reply or scene, or summarizes first if there are none. Open the Post tab for a draft reply; the writers' room stays on the widget, and Make video is also at the top of that section. Tap Post again to close it and keep a compact view. You can select the draft in the widget and copy it. I never post for you.

helpRoomBody.message: On X, Facebook and Instagram, the writers' room stays on the widget even if Listen is open or Post is closed. Pick 2 to 4 characters and a director. They pitch lines, the director picks the best, and you get a short scene about the post. Make video is at the top of this section, and also at the bottom of the widget. You can close Post while a scene plays, and you can select the draft in the widget to copy it. Jokes are about ideas, never people.

helpHotBody.message: Turn it on to rank the posts already on your screen by likes and shared topics. Pick one to riff on.

helpVideoBody.message: After a narration, tap Video to download a clip with the character and captions, ready for you to upload.

helpSettingsBody.message: Tap the person icon to set your name, a little about you, your age range and language. Answers get tailored to you.

sceneCastTooSmall.message: Tick 2 to 4 characters for the scene. Using the core four this time.
